patterns.previous: A Great Sword upgraded from a large bone.{j}A bone Great Sword whose weight gives it destructive power;{j}if you can wield it, you are a full-fledged Hunter.

patterns.source: 姿を見ることさえかなわない、{j}伝説の金竜銀竜の素材を用い{j}た双剣。火属性が非常に強力。
